info.name: Assignment 02 - House-Price API
info.description: POST /predict for the house-price prediction service (Assignment 02, Application 2). Import into Postman, set the {{baseUrl}} collection variable, run the requests. Start the API first:  uvicorn api.main:app --reload --port 8001  (from Assignment_2/).

request.description: Returns { status, model_loaded, model_name }. model_loaded is false until notebook/house_price.ipynb section 22 has produced model/model_pipeline.joblib.

request.description: Every field supplied. Expected response: { predicted_price, price_per_m2, currency, model_name }.
Only the required field. All other columns are imputed by the SAVED pipeline exactly as during training (no new imputer is fitted).
A different property type to show the model handles the full listing mix.
Area is required. FastAPI returns 422 with a validation error body — use this as the 'input validation' evidence for the report.
